top.title: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
top.summary: UN talks in Geneva ended with a pledge to start discussing autonomous weapon rules, giving states two years to propose regulations, while humanitarian groups push for binding limits amid civilian casualties.

top.title: Pandex – Official European Law for AI Agents, over MCP
top.summary: Pandex offers a single API and MCP server delivering EU and national legislation, court decisions, and updates, enabling AI agents to query authoritative legal data across jurisdictions.

top.title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
top.summary: Anthropic’s IPO makes it a top‑valued AI firm, but its safety‑first stance faces pressure from shareholders and massive compute costs, testing its governance model.

top.title: Meta ads is now available in AWS Quick
top.summary: AWS Quick adds a Meta Ads AI connector, letting marketers use natural language to manage and analyze campaigns, generate decks, and automate workflows within a single platform.

top.title: The Outages Are Just Getting Started
top.summary: Experts warn AI‑accelerated vulnerability discovery and rapid patching are overloading legacy infrastructure, contributing to recent high‑profile outages and increasing systemic instability.

top.title: ClawDOS – An AI coding agent for DOS
top.summary: ClawDOS runs an AI coding agent on an original IBM PC XT, using a bridge PC for TLS, demonstrating AI operation within extreme hardware constraints.
